title: Maggy theme
description: A custom Maggy theme: save as ~/.config/maggy/themes/<name>.json (name: letters, digits, - or _, max 24, not a built-in name). The file name is the theme name: `maggy theme <name>`. Every key is optional. Check it with `maggy theme list` (lists skipped files with the reason) and look at it with `maggy preview working --theme <name> --once`. Docs: https://agy-pet.github.io/llms-full.txt

$schema.description: Optional; lets editors validate the file. Ignored by maggy.

description.description: Shown by `maggy theme list`. Longer text is cut to 60 characters.

base.description: Start from a built-in theme and change only what this file sets. `colors` and `sparkles` merge with the base's; other keys replace it. Use "prop": null to drop the base's prop.

colors.description:
Recolor the logo. Keys are regions (crown, arch, body, legs, feet) or single cells a-p. The logo grid, two columns per cell:
    aabb      <- crown: a b
  ccddeeff    <- arch:  c d e f
  gghhiijj    <- body:  g h i j
  kk    ll    <- legs:  k l
mmnn    oopp  <- feet:  m n o p

sparkles.description: Swap the two sparkle glyphs around the logo.

prop.description: A small picture drawn beside the logo (like the xmas tree or cny lantern): up to 5 rows of up to 8 characters. Shorter props stand on the bottom row. Every non-space character needs an entry in prop_cells. null or [] removes the base theme's prop.

prop_cells.description: What each prop character draws. Requires `prop`.

dates.description: Days when theme `auto` shows this theme (local time). On those days it wins over a built-in seasonal theme.

glyph.description: One printable, single-width character (no spaces, no wide CJK or emoji).

propCell.description: One prop cell. Needs at least bg or glyphs.

bg.description: Fill the cell with this color.

glyphs.description: Glyph(s) drawn in the cell, cycled one per frame (max 8).

chase.description: Glyph colors that cycle along the prop each frame, like the tree's lights (use instead of fg; max 8).

blink.description: Twinkle while Maggy is idle: every cell (all) or every other cell (alt).
